_metadata.note: This is a curated reference list for academic demonstration purposes. It is NOT a live CVE database. For production use, integrate with NVD/OSV APIs.

tensorflow.description: Out-of-bounds write in TensorFlow before 2.11.0 via FractionalMaxPool.
TensorFlow Segment Fault via TFLite model parsing.

torch.description: torch.jit.annotations.parse_type_line uses eval() unsafely, allowing arbitrary code execution.
torch.load() with weights_only=True can still execute arbitrary code from a crafted checkpoint.

pillow.description: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Pillow via crafted image files.

scikit-learn.description: Denial of service in scikit-learn SVM via crafted input.

numpy.description: String comparison in NumPy uses C strcmp which may cause issues with untrusted input.

requests.description: Proxy-Authorization header leak on redirect to different host.

cryptography.description: NULL pointer dereference in PKCS12 parsing.

urllib3.description: Request body not stripped after redirect with status code 301/302.
